MD.outcome_capture_method_recommendation: Use validated monthly close from analytics.comercial_proyecto_mes; persist the observed primary metric in decision_intelligence.project_contract_outcome_v292.
MD.roi_measurement_plan_recommendation: Keep action_cost and value_realized separately. When action_cost > 0, report ROI=(value_realized-action_cost)/action_cost. Do not attribute value causally to the intervention without an identification design.
MD.success_criterion_template: Define a numeric threshold ex ante against the frozen baseline for absorcion_promedio_3m and a guardrail for margin/value. Human owner must replace this template before approval.

MT.outcome_capture_method_recommendation: Use validated monthly close from analytics.comercial_proyecto_mes; persist the observed primary metric in decision_intelligence.project_contract_outcome_v292.
MT.roi_measurement_plan_recommendation: Quantify Value to Capture before activation. Track action_cost and value_realized separately; calculate ROI only when both are observed. No causal attribution without an identification design.
MT.success_criterion_template: Define a numeric threshold ex ante against the frozen baseline and Value to Capture. Human owner must replace this template before approval.
